scope: Released-SDK baseline for the WW19 Regional Sales Readout map-layer case.
supported: set_geocoding_context(country='United States') for US state geocoding
set_field_geographic_role for State/City and per-region state fields
configure_chart map_layer_mode='native' with a base state layer plus four region border layers
per-layer has_stroke/stroke_color for the coloured region borders
add_set + add_dashboard_set_action (edit-group-action) for the hover Selected City

findings.summary: The article's 'Region, created from State' custom geographic role has no public API; per-region calculated State fields are the equivalent.
findings.workaround: One State-geocoded field per region (IF [Region]='West' THEN [State] END).

findings.summary: Without set_geocoding_context(country='United States') the State names geocode as world provinces.
findings.upstream_note: Documented API usage: call set_geocoding_context(country='United States') before building.
